Brand strategy & identity

A clear position. An unmistakable presence.

Brand strategy and identity systems for businesses ready to become easier to understand, recognize and choose.

The business problem

Brand strategy & identity with a clear purpose.

When your offer has evolved but your identity has not, every presentation, website and campaign tells a slightly different story. We help define the idea behind the business and turn it into a consistent visual and verbal system.

What we can help you build

Positioning & messaging

Clarify your audience, point of difference and value proposition. Define the messages that need to remain consistent as the business grows.

Visual identity

Develop a coherent identity across logo usage, typography, color, imagery and composition. Existing brand equity is assessed before changes are proposed.

Brand systems & rollout

Create guidelines and practical applications for digital, presentation and campaign use. The handover should help your team make better everyday decisions.

A clear process

  1. Understand the business, audience and competitive context.
  2. Define positioning and review creative territories.
  3. Develop the selected identity across real applications.
  4. Deliver editable assets, usage guidance and rollout priorities.

Built for everyday use

An identity built as a system gives your business a recognizable presence across touchpoints. It also reduces the repeated design decisions that slow down internal teams.

Tools & handover

Editable vector assets, presentation-ready files, digital color specifications and accessible typography guidance. Tools and handover formats are agreed to suit your team.

Questions before you start

Can you work with our existing logo?

Yes. We can build a stronger identity system around a protected logo, or assess a broader evolution where a redesign is appropriate.

Is a logo the same as a brand identity?

A logo identifies the business. A brand identity includes the visual rules, messaging and applications that make the business recognizable in use.

What should we prepare?

Bring your business objectives, current assets, audience information and examples of where the identity needs to work. A finished creative brief is not required.
